notes.title: Embark on Your Magical Journey: RINBO is Now Live on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I'm thrilled to share that RINBO is now live on Steam! Step into the magical shoes of Soren, a young Noble, as he embarks on an epic 3D action-adventure to gain the favor of the demon Dorimkasto. You'll glide through enchanting landscapes, tackle exciting quests, and meet over 100 unique characters along the way. With thrilling combat, rich storytelling, and a captivating soundtrack, I truly believe RINBO offers an unforgettable journey.

Thank you for your support, and I can't wait for you to dive into this magical world. Download RINBO now and start your adventure!

- Dawn Fades

notes.title: RINBO Launches in Less Than a Month - July 26th!
notes.notes:
I am thrilled to announce that RINBO will be officially launching on Steam on July 26th, 2024! Get ready to dive into a captivating world filled with mystery, action, and unforgettable adventures.

Thank you for your support. I can’t wait for you to experience the world of RINBO!

Mark your calendars for July 26th, and get ready for an epic adventure!

Best regards,
Dawn Fades

notes.title: Embark on Soren's Journey: Play the RINBO Demo Today!
notes.notes: Experience the captivating RINBO Demo, featuring the prologue that unfolds on Soren's 11th Birthday, revealing the events that set the stage for Soren's journey into the enchanting lands of RINBO.

notes.title: Release date set: July 19th!
notes.notes:
Hey all! Just a quick announcement that I have now locked in the release date for July 19th 2024.
I hope you are as excited as I am!

notes.title: Brand new trailer and an updated About This Game section for RINBO
notes.notes:
If you are curious about the progress of Rinbo, I have some news to share with you. 
Maybe the best way is to watch the new trailer that was posted recently.
Do you like it?

The About This Game section has been redone with some new art.

Also, the RINBO Demo will be announced in the upcoming weeks so please look forward to that.
Thank you for your continued support.

- Dawn
